detail.longDescription: Let's start with the bad news: Google Tasks doesn't offer much sharing functionality. You can share tasks with team members in a "shared space"—like a chat space or a document—but even then, the functionality is very limited. It's frustrating because when you're collaborating, it's helpful to see the same list of tasks as your co-workers. Not offering a more collaborative tool sets Google Tasks apart from the best to do list apps...in a bad way. But Google Tasks is still worth using. It's quick
